requirements.quote:
When the client has sent the "post_handshake_auth" extension (see
   Section 4.2.6), a server MAY request client authentication
requirements.condition: a server sends a post-handshake CertificateRequest
requirements.required_behavior: ensure the client previously sent the post_handshake_auth extension
requirements.forbidden_behavior: requesting post-handshake authentication from a client that did not offer post_handshake_auth
requirements.why_checkable: The server's request emission can be compared with the recorded ClientHello extensions.

requirements.quote:
a server MAY request client authentication at any
   time after the handshake has completed by sending a
   CertificateRequest message.
requirements.condition: a server sends a post-handshake CertificateRequest
requirements.required_behavior: send it only after the handshake has completed
requirements.forbidden_behavior: sending a post-handshake CertificateRequest before handshake completion
requirements.why_checkable: The message position can be checked against the handshake completion transition.

requirements.quote:
The client MUST respond with the
   appropriate Authentication messages (see Section 4.4).
requirements.condition: a client receives a valid post-handshake CertificateRequest
requirements.required_behavior: send the applicable client Authentication response messages
requirements.why_checkable: A post-handshake trace can verify that each accepted request receives a response.

requirements.quote:
If the client
   chooses to authenticate, it MUST send Certificate, CertificateVerify,



Rescorla                     Standards Track                   [Page 75]

RFC 8446                           TLS                       August 2018


   and Finished.
requirements.condition: the client accepts a post-handshake authentication request and chooses to authenticate
requirements.required_behavior: send Certificate, then CertificateVerify, then Finished
requirements.forbidden_behavior: omitting or reordering any message in the authentication sequence
requirements.why_checkable: The required three-message sequence and order are visible on the wire.

requirements.quote:
If it declines, it MUST send a Certificate message
   containing no certificates followed by Finished.
requirements.condition: the client declines a post-handshake authentication request
requirements.required_behavior: send an empty Certificate message followed by Finished
requirements.forbidden_behavior: omitting Finished, including certificates, or reordering the two messages
requirements.why_checkable: The response body and two-message ordering are directly observable.

requirements.quote:
All of the client's
   messages for a given response MUST appear consecutively on the wire
   with no intervening messages of other types.
requirements.condition: a client sends messages for one post-handshake authentication response
requirements.required_behavior: send all messages for that response consecutively
requirements.forbidden_behavior: interleaving messages of other types within the response sequence
requirements.why_checkable: Wire-message adjacency can be checked for each certificate request context.

requirements.quote:
A client that receives a CertificateRequest message without having
   sent the "post_handshake_auth" extension MUST send an
   "unexpected_message" fatal alert.
requirements.condition: a client receives CertificateRequest without previously offering post_handshake_auth
requirements.forbidden_behavior: processing or answering the unauthorized CertificateRequest
requirements.why_checkable: A missing-extension test has an exact required fatal alert.

requirements.quote:
servers MUST be prepared for some delay, including receiving an
   arbitrary number of other messages between sending the
   CertificateRequest and receiving a response.
requirements.condition: a server is awaiting a post-handshake authentication response
requirements.required_behavior: continue to handle otherwise valid intervening messages without requiring an immediate response
requirements.forbidden_behavior: treating intervening messages or response delay alone as a protocol violation
requirements.why_checkable: Tests can insert multiple valid messages before the authentication response and observe server handling.
